folds.heading: ## Subtle-body reconciliation B117, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full SOCIAL/PSYCHOLOGY/INFORMATION_AND_TIMING/CONSEQUENCES/EVENT_SHAPES and REPORT read. Preserve 30 original rows, ten proposed additions and all E01–E41, with their different denominators. Useful additions include accommodation before diagnosis, observer-specific recognition repair, separate confidence/competence, delight/belonging, permission versus memory, correlated/unit-mismatched evidence, appointments versus physiological change, immutable sample versus delivery, living-provider continuity and genuinely freed capacity. None becomes a mandatory downside, emotional interpretation, upkeep or replacement crisis. Requests/duties are not accepted obligations; disclosure needs actual recipients; supportive or exact exceptional means can resolve a problem cleanly.

Physical truth, observed evidence, interpreted belief, chosen self-meaning, legal recognition and actual action/resource outcome keep distinct owners. Every downstream consequence needs its actual input/exposure/actor/contact/result chain, not an ecology/law/social change from a sentence. A certificate sampled earlier remains that assay even if delivery follows a body change. Revocation changes future access, not received memory; a hidden change cannot make a visible stale warning. Appointment expiry is not bodily settlement or deliberate refusal. Creation inputs freeze at their real event, and later parental changes/claims cannot rewrite existing children or stock.

EV1–EV10 are proposed bindings and specified tests, not admitted APIs/registered decks/computed FNV fixtures. Reuse the current selected stream/deck owner before adding a cast/wording provider; preserve compatibility for any deliberately selected algorithm rather than silently reroll. One authored candidate needs no draw. Source truth, noisy assay and delivery selection remain different operations. P3 arrival supersedes initial absence, but a world skin does not prove a real response host or keyboard-focus behavior. Native ticks retain their save cadence; selected staged commands require actual durable publication and failure proof. Active references/terms/custody survive feed/memory pruning.

Current desktop/laptop direction and optional human review under AD42 in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md) qualify fixed-viewport/G7 language. A1–A5 remain inferred-cost suggestions, not a launch or measured estimate. Broad P19/P23/P24 implementation is not automatically prerequisite to a bounded authored version. Historical locators/hashes/source audit and peer proof do not establish current APIs, our transitive reading of all dependencies, or rebuilt play. No implementation or new canon/private-source verification was performed.

folds.heading: ## Social and timing palette reconciliation B117, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete [B14 packet](gm/dispatch/body-lineage-2026-10-14/b14/REPORT.md#subtle-body-reconciliation-b117-2026-11-04) preserves 40 palette rows and 41 event recipes with scoped owners. Keep accommodation before diagnosis, positive/neutral changed-body meanings, confidence separate from competence, access separate from memory, sample/assay/arrival dates separate, and provider continuity/freed capacity tied to actual jobs. Appointments do not mutate physiology; a report does not create ecology, law or NPC knowledge. These proposals do not select a work wave, demand broad social/psychology engines first or impose new body penalties. AD42 human review is optional; selected runtime must establish its own current owners and proof.
